meta_description:
katyperry on September 21, 2026: "Can’t wait to spend a whole day at the @lucasmuseum when it opens up… This museum is for the people and has my favorite kind of art in it… the kind that moves you, makes you feel, and inspires your own hero’s story within.

Thanks for having us George Lucas. What an absolute honor of epic proportions!".
